name: Devilwing Badge (Greater)
text:
This small tearing of a devil's wing has been cleansed with holy water before being mounted onto a silver badge. The spell attack modifier of any spell cast by Activating this item is +14, and the spell DC is 24.
- Armor You gain resistance 5 to fire and unholy.
- Weapon After you cast a spell by Activating the devilwing badge, your Strikes with the weapon deal an additional 1d6 spirit damage until the end of your next turn.
